ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with a high contrast ratio; approximately 95% dark pixels to 5% high-intensity white pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed white mottling across both lobes; concentrated high-intensity clusters at the distal tips; three distinct circular white spots in the mid-region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch, approximately 40-45 degrees, with a depth approximately 1/8th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the distal third of both trailing edges; irregular peaks and valleys with 5-15 pixel amplitude variations; medial regions near the notch are relatively smoother.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve transitioning from a concave sweep near the median notch to a convex trailing sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular white clusters (rosettes) present in the center-right lobe; dense, irregular white calcification/scarring clusters at the distal-most points of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent diagonal white linear disruption (rake-like mark) visible on the lower medial quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive textured scarring and calcification (consistent with barnacle colonization) on the extreme distal edges of both lobes, creating a jagged white boundary.
